theme: कर्म न करने का असर — The consequences of withdrawing from action
context: Krishna continues his explanation of why he acts despite having nothing to gain. He describes what he says would follow if he did not act: disorder and harm to living beings. The next verse will compare this with how wise people act.
contextHindi: कृष्ण पिछले विचार को आगे बढ़ाते हैं: यदि वे कर्म न करें, तो संसार में अव्यवस्था और प्राणियों को हानि हो सकती है। अगले श्लोक में वे ज्ञानी लोगों के कर्म करने के ढंग की बात करेंगे।
sanskritDevanagari:
उत्सीदेयुरिमे लोका न कुर्यां कर्म चेदहम् |
सङ्करस्य च कर्ता स्यामुपहन्यामिमाः प्रजाः ||३-२४||
transliteration:
utsīdeyurime lokā na kuryāṃ karma cedaham .
saṅkarasya ca kartā syāmupahanyāmimāḥ prajāḥ ||3-24||

wordByWord.meaning: They would decline, collapse, or fall into disorder; the verse describes a feared consequence.
Worlds or people and their shared social worlds, depending on how the term is read in context.
If I did not do or perform; a hypothetical condition.
Of mixture or disorder; the Divine Life Society edition renders the phrase as confusion of castes.
I would become the cause or agent of; Krishna describes responsibility for a consequence.
I would harm, injure, or bring destruction upon.

spokenHindi: इस श्लोक में कृष्ण अपनी बात को गंभीर परिणामों के रूप में रखते हैं। वे कहते हैं कि यदि वे कर्म न करें, तो लोकों का पतन हो सकता है, वे सङ्कर के कारण बन सकते हैं और प्रजाओं को हानि पहुँचा सकते हैं। यहाँ सङ्कर का अर्थ समझते समय सावधानी चाहिए। दिव्य जीवन सोसाइटी का अंग्रेज़ी अनुवाद इसे जातियों का भ्रम कहता है; संस्कृत पद का अर्थ मिश्रण या अव्यवस्था भी हो सकता है। इसलिए इस एक पद से किसी जाति-व्यवस्था का पूरा सिद्धांत निकालना ठीक नहीं। पाठ में कृष्ण अपने न करने के संभावित परिणाम की जिम्मेदारी बता रहे हैं। इससे यह निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है कि जिनके निर्णय दूसरों को प्रभावित करते हैं, उन्हें अपने हट जाने के असर पर भी विचार करना चाहिए। इसका अर्थ यह नहीं कि एक व्यक्ति सबको नियंत्रित कर सकता है, या हर समस्या उसी पर निर्भर है। आज किसी साझा काम में अचानक पीछे हटने से दूसरों पर बोझ पड़ सकता है; वहीं अस्वस्थ या अन्यायपूर्ण व्यवस्था से सीमाएँ बनाना उचित हो सकता है। पहले संवाद करें, असर समझें और संभव हो तो जिम्मेदारी का सुरक्षित हस्तांतरण करें।
clearEnglish: Krishna makes the stakes of his hypothetical explicit: if he did not act, he says, the worlds would decline, he would become a cause of saṅkara, and he would harm living beings. The Divine Life Society edition translates saṅkara here as “confusion of castes.” The Sanskrit term can also carry a sense of mixture or disorder, so it is important not to treat a single translation as a complete social doctrine. The verse’s immediate argument is about the consequences Krishna attributes to his own withdrawal from action. A reasonable inference is that people with influence should consider how their absence or choices affect others. That is not a claim that one person controls society, nor a rule that someone must remain in a harmful situation. In everyday life, suddenly abandoning a shared responsibility can transfer burdens to others; stepping back from unsafe or unjust demands may still be necessary. When possible, communicate, assess who may be affected, and arrange a responsible handover. The verse invites attention to consequences, not panic or self-blame for problems beyond one’s control.

interpretationPerspectives.label: TEXT
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: Krishna says that his not acting would lead to the decline of the worlds, saṅkara, and harm to living beings. The verse states his account of a hypothetical consequence.

interpretationPerspectives.label: COMMENTARY
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The Divine Life Society edition translates saṅkara in this verse as “confusion of castes.” That is the edition’s rendering; the Sanskrit word can be broader, and the verse alone does not settle every later social interpretation.

interpretationPerspectives.label: INFERENCE
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: When a person’s role affects others, it is responsible to consider the effects of withdrawing. This does not mean that every duty is fair, that one person is responsible for all social outcomes, or that harmful conditions must be endured.

practicalApplication.label: Consider who is affected
practicalApplication.text: Before withdrawing from a shared commitment, identify who may bear the extra burden and communicate a realistic plan where possible.

practicalApplication.label: Keep a boundary
practicalApplication.text: If a role is unsafe or harmful, seek support and make a safe transition rather than treating this verse as a demand to endure it.

reflectionQuestion: When I step back from a responsibility, have I considered who may be affected and how to respond responsibly?
reflectionQuestionHindi: किसी जिम्मेदारी से पीछे हटते समय, क्या मैंने सोचा है कि किस पर असर पड़ेगा और जिम्मेदारी से कैसे आगे बढ़ा जा सकता है?
